Actions taken to support the use of open data provide indications of commitment by organizations to users.

## Data Products

The creation of new datasets may represent the fulfillment of public requests [@mergel2018] or signify successful collaboration with departments to publish data that demonstrates their work on behalf of the public [@johnson2016].

Datasets can be measured by their value to departments and the public. Dataset characteristics like category, agency function, expected user group, information type, and related open government principle have been used to evaluate the public usefulness of a data catalog [@schwoerer2022]. The evaluation of metadata completion, communication mechanisms, and publishing frequency provides a way to track the commitment of a program to providing open data [@nahon2015].
